class.name: TrainElectricInductionEngine
class.brief_description: Subclass of TrainElectricEngine for inverter-fed asynchronous (induction) traction motors.
class.description: [TrainElectricInductionEngine] wraps the inverter-fed asynchronous motor variant of the FIZ [code]Engine:[/code] section (used when [code]EngineType=ElectricInductionMotor[/code]).

members.member: [code]Engine:Vh1[/code] Velocity below which ED braking force starts to decay (minimum velocity of full braking force).
[code]Engine:Vh0[/code] Velocity at which ED braking force has fully decayed to zero.
[code]Engine:icif[/code] Ratio converting motor current to three-phase current.
[code]Engine:cim[/code] Ratio converting current to motor torque.
[code]Engine:a1[/code] Traction force drop rate, in kN per km/h.
[code]Engine:F0[/code] Initial (starting) traction force, in kN.
[code]Engine:fcfu[/code] Inverter U/f setpoint.
[code]Engine:fcfuH[/code] Inverter U/f setpoint during ED braking.
[code]Engine:DU[/code] Voltage drop across the inverter.
[code]Engine:Fh[/code] Maximum ED braking force, in kN.
[code]Engine:Ph[/code] Maximum ED braking power.
[code]Engine:Pmax[/code] Maximum traction power.

[code]Pmaxlist[/code] (undocumented on the wiki) Maximum power as a function of velocity; see [code]EIM_Pmax_Table[/code] in [code]MOVER.h[/code]. Each item's [member CurvePointItem.x] is velocity and [member CurvePointItem.y] is the maximum power at that velocity.
[code]Engine:dfmax[/code] Maximum motor slip.
[code]Engine:Uzmax[/code] Maximum supply voltage.
[code]Engine:Uzh[/code] Maximum supply voltage during ED braking.
[code]Engine:Imax[/code] Maximum current setting for this unit's motors.
[code]Engine:I0[/code] No-load (idle) current.
[code]Engine:cfu[/code] Nominal U/f ratio of the motor.
[code]Engine:p[/code] Number of motor pole pairs.
[code]Engine:dfic[/code] Ratio of motor current to the difference between field and motor speed.
